svg.title: The reader's calls on {"a":[1,"x"]}: where in the text it is, and the calls on the C stack, one more for each value inside another; then the depth cap at 64
svg.text: json.c at 07.03, with a line printed as each of its readers starts and returns

g.title: jsonParse() calls jsonValue() at 0. It sees '{' and calls jsonList(): an object, one level deep.
g.text: the calls on the C stack, the latest on top

g.title: In an object each member starts with a key: jsonString() at 1 reads "a". Then a ':' must follow.
g.text: the calls on the C stack, the latest on top

g.title: The member's value: jsonValue() at 5 sees '[' and calls jsonList() again, for the array inside: two levels deep.
g.text: the calls on the C stack, the latest on top

g.title: jsonValue() at 6 sees a digit: jsonNumber() reads 1, the array's first element.
g.text: the calls on the C stack, the latest on top

g.title: After the ',', jsonValue() at 8 sees a quote: jsonString() reads "x".
g.text: the calls on the C stack, the latest on top

g.title: The ']' at 11 ends the array: its jsonList() returns it, the depth is one again, and the object's loop goes on.
g.text: the calls on the C stack, the latest on top

g.title: The '}' at 12 ends the object. jsonValue() returns the tree to jsonParse(), at 13: nothing is left after the value, so the message is one value.
g.text: the calls on the C stack, the latest on top

g.title: The cap: 65 '[' one inside another. Each level is two more calls on the C stack; 64 levels read, but the 65th jsonList() makes the depth 65, more than 64, and returns NULL, and so does every call under it: no tree, and the message is dropped.
g.text: the calls on the C stack, the latest on top
